verdict.rationale: Letta gives users some control over where data lives and how long it persists — local-only mode with no cloud login (letta-docs-31), fully on-device state with no account required (letta-docs-74), self-hosting on your own infrastructure (letta-docs-30), and an --ephemeral flag that avoids creating/persisting any agent, memory, or MemFS state (letta-docs-14). However, there is no documented explicit 'delete agent/account/data' command, API, or retention policy, no data-export/erasure workflow, and no mention of cloud-side deletion guarantees for agents backed up via /login. missing for 10: explicit delete/erase agent or account data API, documented retention windows for cloud-backed data, and independent confirmation that self-hosted/ephemeral modes leave no residual data.
